function.name: check_contact
function.description: Searches if a contact exists in the CRM (GoHighLevel) for the current client. On inbound calls the caller's phone is auto-resolved from call metadata, so you can call this tool with no arguments. Optionally pass 'phone' or 'query' to search by a different value (e.g. when the caller gives a different number, email, or name). Returns found: true with contactId, firstName, lastName, email, phone and tags when a contact exists; returns found: false otherwise (ghost contacts with no name/email are also treated as not found). Tags are returned raw — interpret them according to your client's playbook.

phone.description: Phone number to search for, including country code (e.g. '+12125550000'). Optional — leave blank to use the inbound caller's phone automatically.

query.description: Free-text query to search the CRM by (name, email, or any contact field). Optional — only use when you need to look up a contact by something other than phone.

function.name: create_contact
function.description: Creates or upserts a contact in the CRM (GoHighLevel) for the current client. Call this only after check_contact returned found: false. Phone is required; pass firstName, lastName, and email whenever the caller shares them. Returns the contactId, which you must use for any subsequent scheduling or tagging tool in the same call.

phone.description: Contact phone number including country code (e.g. '+12125550000').

firstName.description: Contact first name. Optional but recommended — collect from the caller if they share it.

lastName.description: Contact last name. Optional but recommended — collect from the caller if they share it.

email.description: Contact email address. Optional but recommended — collect from the caller if they share it.
